argv: G="env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_INDEX_FILE -u GIT_COMMON_DIR git"; $G log --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -- PROVINCE.md | cat; first=$($G log --format=%h --reverse -- PROVINCE.md | head -1); echo "first=$first"; $G show $first:PROVINCE.md | nl -ba | sed -n "14,17p"; echo "--- line-1..20 diff first->read-rev:"; diff <($G show $first:PROVINCE.md | sed -n 1,20p) <(sed -n 1,20p PROVINCE.md) && echo identical-1-20; echo "--- arm-class-matrix calibration mentions:"; grep -n "6/10\|7/10\|failing-case count\|E1" corpus/knowledge/arm-class-matrix.md | cut -c1-220
